propositions: Documentation must explain that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix URLs served by the optional git-remote-s3 helper and cross-link to the new backend guide.

A new operator guide docs/s3-backend.md must document installation (pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' with git-remote-s3>=0.3.2), SSE-KMS bucket/IAM/CMK setup, remote configuration, trust boundary (AWS credentials via boto3, SSE-KMS encryption, SigV4 access), and auto-doctor stale-lock self-heal behavior (60s TTL via GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS).
A new ADR 0093 must record the decision to use git-remote-s3 below the git layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, implement merge-based auto-doctor to handle multi-bundle state, and reject TTL lowering.

The ADR number marker docs/adr/.numbers/0093 and regenerated docs/adr/README.md must be committed after running scripts/gen_adr_index.py, with scripts/check_adr_numbers.py and gen_adr_index.py --check passing in CI.
Both new pages must be discoverable from docs/README.md: s3-backend.md linked directly and ADR 0093 discoverable via the generated docs/adr/README.md index.
